validated_work_order.approach: Build one vertical slice: a pure measurement domain (funnel + maturity + policy bands) consumed by a new POST /v1/events ingest route and a GET /v1/metrics read route, rendered by the dashboard KPI strip with maturity bars and a stale banner. Reuse the foundation envelope (tenant_id, event_id idempotency via INSERT OR IGNORE), money micros, UTC timestamps, append-only raw_events and the {code,message} error envelope. Ingest accepts the spec growth-event shape and normalises it to the internal envelope; metrics are computed on read from raw_events so no migration is needed. Dashboard ideal shows qualified CPL/volume/coverage with badges; partial shows the stale banner plus maturity bars with data-through timestamps; loading skeleton and error panel already exist and are kept. The owner decision (Meta first, Google later, plan/brief.md) does not change this slice: measurement stays platform-agnostic and no adapter code is touched; dashboard setup copy keeps the existing connect-Meta checklist. Seam: any 4xx from POST surfaces inline field errors and never writes; dashboard read failures render the existing error panel naming the failing check with last-good timestamp and a Retry button.
assumptions: Single-operator v1: tenant resolves from optional tenant_id field, else the sole existing tenant, else tenant_demo; no auth layer in this slice
Default lag model p50 48h / p90 120h for qualification until per-account learning arrives in a later epic
Stale threshold 24h past last good sync; thresholds are constants in the measurement module
validated_work_order.confidence_rationale: Foundation already provides envelope validation, idempotent raw_events, derived spend replay and all five dashboard shells; the slice adds pure math plus two routes with no migration and no new dependency.

validated_work_order.understanding: Issue #17 is the measurement-truth slice of epic #14: growth leads see owned qualified CPL against platform CPL with maturity badges instead of the system acting on immature conversions. The foundation (#16, done) already gives raw_events with (tenant_id, event_id) idempotency, UTC envelope validation, money micros, append-only audit and dashboard shells whose KPI strip today shows spend/qualified counts with hardcoded 0.00 coverage. Missing is the contract face (POST /v1/events for lead-through-margin growth events, privacy-aware journey graph, downstream quality funnel) and the UI face upgrade (qualified CPL/volume/coverage with maturity 0..1, lag distributions, TR-7 policy bands, maturity bars with data-through timestamps, stale banner, strategic-action gating). Out of scope: adapter reads, shadow/calibration, ad mutation.
